title: Lower body + elbow test · 2 October
label: 40-MINUTE LOWER BODY · CALF PT + ELBOW TEST
coachNote: Right elbow still symptomatic and swimming aggravated it yesterday. Make this a lower-body session, not an upper-body workout. SUPERSETS: A1 Leg extension → A2 Leg curl, rest ~60 sec × 3. B1 Leg press → B2 Hip thrust, rest 75–90 sec × 3. Then calf PT and seated calf raises, followed by elbow-free core. Optional elbow test: ONE very light set of only one movement you want to assess; record pain 0–10 and stop if pain is clearly reproduced or increases rep-to-rep. Do NOT retest the palms-up wrist curl today.

exercises.name: A1 · SUPERSET A — Leg extension
exercises.note: Last session: 36×12, 36×12, 50×12 at RPE 5, pain 0. Use controlled reps.

exercises.name: A2 · SUPERSET A — Leg curl
exercises.note: Last session: 29 kg × 12 × 3 at RPE 5, pain 0. Increase modestly only if easy. Rest ~60 sec after A2.

exercises.name: B1 · SUPERSET B — 45° leg press
exercises.note: Last session: 40×10, 60×10, 40×10 at RPE 5. Record plates added and note whether load includes sled.

exercises.name: B2 · SUPERSET B — Hip thrust
exercises.target: 3 × 10 @ 50 kg; modest increase only if clearly easy
exercises.note: Last session reached 50 kg × 10 for two sets at RPE 5. Controlled lockout; no low-back hyperextension. Rest 75–90 sec after B2.

exercises.name: PT · Single-leg standing calf raise
exercises.note: PT priority. Full rise, brief top hold, ~3-second lowering. Recent session was pain-free.

exercises.name: PT · Seated calf raise
exercises.note: Controlled full range. Please record the actual resistance/load today.

exercises.name: OPTIONAL · One light elbow test
exercises.note: Diagnostic trial, not training. Record the movement as substitution, actual load/reps, and elbow pain 0–10. Stop if pain is clearly reproduced or increases. Do NOT use the palms-up wrist curl today.
